title: clinvar.ingestion.completed
description: Producer: clinvar-service (app/kafka_producer.py's IngestionCompletedEvent, ADR 0019). newReleaseId replaces ADR 0018's original releaseId field name for symmetry with previousReleaseId; changedKeys is the ADR 0019 addition that lets api invalidate its cache without re-reading a tabix file itself. backlog #141: changedKeys.items now has a real pattern, not just minLength -- the previous minLength-only shape let this file's own committed example drift from the real producer's actual key format (app/diff.py's _make_key, 'variantAnnotation:{chrom}:{pos}:{ref}:{alt}') for weeks with no CI check able to catch it, since any non-empty string satisfied minLength equally.
